name: Lauryn Widget Suite for Elementor
author: lauryn77

sections.description:
Lauryn Widget Suite adds focused widgets for Elementor. Stacking Cards supports manual cards and automatic Latest Posts. Service Card provides a flexible, modular layout for services, treatments, consultations, packages and pricing-style content.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor Ltd.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor.
  2. Upload and activate Lauryn Widget Suite for Elementor.
  3. Edit a page with Elementor.
  4. Find the “Lauryn Widgets” category and drag a widget into the page.
sections.changelog:
0.2.3

  • Matched the Stacking Cards mobile geometry to the proven FirmatoB implementation.
  • Prevented horizontal page overflow while preserving the visible card pile and natural shadows.

0.2.2

  • Fixed Service Card button attribute rendering to satisfy WordPress output escaping checks.
  • Updated Tested up to for WordPress 7.1.

0.2.1

  • Added Equal Height and Footer Alignment controls to Service Card.

0.2.0

  • Added the new Service Card widget.
  • Added optional image, ribbon, image tags, subtitle, title, WYSIWYG description, features, duration, price and button.
  • Added responsive inline/stacked feature layout.
  • Added comprehensive style controls for every Service Card section.
  • Added flexible text-based pricing and suffix fields.

0.1.5

  • Added a shared Image style section for both Manual Cards and Latest Posts.
  • Added image Size controls: Cover, Contain and Auto.
  • Added image Position controls.
  • Added No Repeat, Repeat, Repeat Horizontally and Repeat Vertically controls.
  • Image rendering now uses a background layer so all display modes behave consistently.

0.1.4

  • Added a Source selector with Manual Cards and Latest Posts modes.
  • Latest Posts works without Elementor Pro.
  • Added number of posts, category, order by, order, excerpt length and global button text controls.
  • Automatic cards use the post featured image, title, excerpt and permalink.

0.1.3

  • Added responsive card border radius.
  • Added info box border radius and inner padding.
  • Added responsive button padding and border radius.
  • Button text remains editable per card in the Cards repeater.

0.1.2

  • Added Elementor Style controls for card/content backgrounds, title/subtitle typography and colors, and button typography/colors with hover states.

0.1.1

  • Added editable/reorderable cards with an Elementor Repeater.
  • Added image, title, subtitle, fallback color, button text and URL per card.
  • Prevented buttons and links from triggering card dragging.

0.1.0

  • Initial prototype.
  • Added Lauryn Widgets category.
  • Added Stacking Cards with four demo cards.
  • Added responsive card size, offsets and rotation controls.
  • Added swipe threshold control.
